activity.notes: Kakuei Tanaka served continuously as Prime Minister of Japan from 7 July 1972 to 9 December 1974. His first and second cabinets are not split into separate ATLAS Activities because there was no interruption in his tenure as prime minister.

sources.title: 64th TANAKA Kakuei — Prime Minister of Japan and His Cabinet
sources.citation_text: The official Prime Minister's Office records Tanaka's first premiership beginning on 7 July 1972.

sources.title: 65th TANAKA Kakuei — Prime Minister of Japan and His Cabinet
sources.citation_text: The official Prime Minister's Office records Tanaka's second cabinet ending on 9 December 1974.
